messages:
maria: Observed multi-node TP jobs (4 nodes) intermittently stalling around step ~1500. Not a hard hang — all ranks block on all-reduce and we see KV cache refill bursts around the same time. Attaching quick profile below, anyone seen this pattern?

jake: can you paste rendezvous / nccl logs? smells like rank desync or lots of small allreduce fragments.

maria: log snippet: 
```
[2025-02-28 14:21:09] RANK 2: rendezvous: waiting for peers
[2025-02-28 14:21:12] RANK 2: allreduce: start->end 36.2ms
[2025-02-28 14:21:12] KVCache: refill 4 keys, latency 28.5ms
[2025-02-28 14:21:40] RANK 0: heartbeat missed, triggering timeout
```

eli: interesting — allreduce ~36ms vs compute ~12ms in profile? paste the flame or top-line numbers.

maria: profile (rank0 sample):
```
Compute kernel time: 11.8ms
AllReduce (NCCL) total: 34.7ms
Idle waiting for comm: 22.1ms
KVCache serialize: 18.3ms
```

arun: KV cache serialize ~18ms is pretty high. Are we serializing big prefix blobs synchronously during TP microbatches? Could be an eviction/regen race when microbatches cross node boundaries.

sophia: can we reproduce with smaller microbatches? e.g. `--batch-size 1 --microbatches 2` — if it's a batching heuristic edge-case it may show.

maria: repro command I used:
```
REDWOOD_DEBUG_PROF=1 ./bench_tp.py --nodes 4 --gpus-per-node 8 --seq-len 2048 --microbatches 4
```

jake: try forcing kernel selector to prefer fused attention: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=attn_fused`. Suspect the selector picked a matmul-fallback path that inserts extra syncs.

maria: tried that — allreduce latency dropped ~8ms but stalls still cropped up occasionally.

perf-bot: suggestion: collect `nvprof`/Nsight or `nv-nsight-cu` run and enable `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` to see message sizes and fragmentation. Also capture `REDWOOD_KERNEL_TRACE=1`.

eli: also try `REDWOOD_KVCACHE_MODE=lazy` to avoid synchronous refill during forward, see if serialization drops.

maria: good call — lazy mode cut serialized KV writes. After switching `REDWOOD_KVCACHE_MODE=lazy` we saw fewer step stalls in 10 trial runs :thumbsup:.

arun: still worth root-causing. Hypothesis: under particular TP slice sizes the kernel selector chooses an implementation that increases NCCL fragmentation (more smaller allreduce ops), increasing latency and exposing kv-cache timing spikes.

sophia: action items: 
- maria: collect `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` traces for one failing run (will do EOD)
- jake: add a microbenchmark that simulates TP partition sizes and counts allreduce message counts
- eli: capture kernel selector decision trace for the failing config

maria: pinging @eng-oncall for node-level perf traces and NIC counters :bell:

jake: repro hint: try `--kv-serialize=false` to confirm kv serialization contribution.

maria: quick update: with `REDWOOD_KVCACHE_MODE=lazy` + `REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=attn_fused`, ran 20 consecutive benchmarks, 20/20 completed without rendezvous timeout. Still collecting NCCL logs for the intermittent failures we saw before.

sophia: great — if NCCL traces show lots of small messages we should adjust kernel-selection heuristic to prefer fewer external comm fragments even at cost of ~2ms extra local compute.

maria: uploading logs to `/shared/infra/tp-stalls/1738204832/` (NCCL, kernel-trace, profiler flame). Will link exact files in the thread when uploaded.

eli: :eyes: keep us posted. If we confirm kernel->fragmentation chain we can add a quick guard in the selector and a perf test in CI.

maria: thanks all — will post collected traces here, and open a follow-up RFC if we need a selector change.
